generate_lora_config_filename: generate a config filename for a LoRA kernel given kernel type, K, R, and S parameters
load_lora_kernel_configs: load pre-tuned LoRA kernel configs from JSON files keyed by chunk_size with triton version fallback
get_shrink_block_sizes: get auto-tuned block sizes for the CSGMV shrink (lora_a) kernel with closest-chunk fallback
get_expand_block_sizes: get auto-tuned block sizes for the CSGMV expand (lora_b) kernel with closest-chunk fallback
run_lora_csgmv_tuning: run the offline tuning script to generate auto-tuned LoRA CSGMV kernel block size configs
